translation: Regularly take Zheng Gu Zi Jin Dan (正骨紫金丹). Externally, use San Yu He Shang Tang (散瘀和傷湯) to wash off the previously applied Hunyuan Ointment (混元膏), then apply Hunyuan Ointment again. After taking the pill medicine, if the stool is black and dry, this is because the intestines and stomach contain stagnant blood; or if there is deafness, in both cases take Jia Jian Su Zi Tao Ren Tang (加減蘇子桃仁湯) to expel the stagnant blood, strengthen the spleen and stomach, nourish the spirit, and also use Dao Qi Tong Yu Ding (導氣通瘀錠) inserted into the ear. The diet should be plain congee and soup; avoid anger, greasy food, and wheat-flour foods.
